blocks.text: Data backup means making a copy of important data. It helps protect data from loss or damage. Data can be lost due to viruses or hardware failure. Backup allows data to be restored easily. Recovery is the process of getting data back. Backup and recovery are very important for safety. Every user should back up data regularly.

There are different types of data backup. Full backup saves all data at once. Incremental backup saves only changed data. Differential backup saves changes since last full backup. Backups can be stored on hard drives. Cloud storage is also used for backup.

Data recovery is used to restore lost data. Backup files are used for recovery. Recovery software helps get deleted files. System restore can recover system data. Professionals can recover data from damaged devices. Recovery methods help reduce data loss.
